panel.request: Update the HVCG homepage headline to emphasize strategic capital advisory and business growth.
panel.originalContent: Find out what is preventing your business from growing, qualifying for capital, or becoming more valuable.

aiProposals.label: Variant A — Strategic growth emphasis
aiProposals.text: Strategic capital advisory that helps your business grow, qualify for capital, and increase enterprise value.
aiProposals.brandConsistencyNotes: Keeps HVCG capital + growth language; slightly more advisory tone than the diagnostic original.
aiProposals.seoImplications: Adds “strategic capital advisory” and “enterprise value” phrases useful for advisory intent queries; longer than current H1.
aiProposals.ctaImplications: Supports EVA / consultation CTAs by framing advisory outcomes rather than only a diagnostic question.
aiProposals.readabilityNotes: Single sentence, clear benefit stack; moderate length.
risks: Slightly less “curiosity gap” than the current question-form H1

aiProposals.label: Variant B — Recommended (balanced)
aiProposals.text: Strategic capital advisory for business growth — find what is holding you back from capital and higher enterprise value.
aiProposals.recommendationReason: Balances brand diagnostic voice with explicit strategic capital advisory and growth framing Manny requested, without inventing credentials or outcomes.
aiProposals.brandConsistencyNotes: Preserves HVCG “find what is holding you back” motif while elevating strategic capital advisory.
aiProposals.seoImplications: Targets strategic capital advisory + business growth + enterprise value; should not change title/meta unless separately requested.
aiProposals.ctaImplications: Pairs well with Schedule / EVA CTAs; does not alter CTA labels.
aiProposals.readabilityNotes: Readable at a glance; em dash separates promise and diagnostic hook.
risks: Em dash may wrap awkwardly on very small mobile widths

aiProposals.label: Variant C — Concise advisory
aiProposals.text: Strategic capital advisory to grow your business and increase enterprise value.
aiProposals.brandConsistencyNotes: Most concise; drops the diagnostic question style of the current homepage.
aiProposals.seoImplications: Strong head-term focus; may reduce long-tail “what is preventing” query overlap.
aiProposals.ctaImplications: More declarative; CTA must carry the diagnostic invitation.
aiProposals.readabilityNotes: Short and scannable; good mobile fit.
risks: Largest departure from the proven current H1 pattern

panel.mannyFinalWording: Strategic capital advisory to help your business grow, qualify for capital, and build enterprise value.
panel.seoResult: H1 wording only — title/meta/canonical/JSON-LD unchanged unless separately requested
